description: This file defines the AzureBlobGrainStorage class, a storage provider for Orleans that persists grain state data to Azure Blob Storage in JSON format. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as initialization and logging functionalities.

classes.name: AzureBlobGrainStorage
classes.description: A storage provider class for persisting grain state data to Azure Blob Storage, implementing IGrainStorage and ILifecycleParticipant for lifecycle management.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state data from Azure Blob Storage asynchronously, handling not found and error cases.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes grain state data to Azure Blob Storage asynchronously, creating container if necessary.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes grain state data from Azure Blob Storage asynchronously, based on configuration.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle for initialization.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the storage provider, creating the Blob service client and container factory.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state to BinaryData using configured serializer.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData to grain state object.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object using the activator provider.
